name: M12 study6 prospective bank7 bounded PubMed source discovery

method.source: Official NCBI PubMed ESearch and EFetch E-utilities
method.pacing: 1.1 seconds between 12 ESearch requests; no retries; single bulk candidate EFetch and single exact-12 source EFetch.
method.query_batch: Twelve fixed broad 2025–2026 category queries, retmax=12, sorted by publication date; no draft-text queries or result-driven refinement.
method.selection: Purposive title/abstract selection for primary-research type, abstract-supported claims, and six within-domain positive/control pairs.
not_performed: No query optimization using retrieval outcomes
